STEP 1 - Scene: This is a light meal or snack. It has two baked egg bites (they look like sous-vide style egg bites or mini quiches with cheese), a piece of cucumber, and baby carrots.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white rimmed dinner plate, about 27 cm across, so the area is 3.14 × 13.5² ≈ 572 cm². The rim is wide, so the inner well is smaller.

STEP 3 - Items:
- 2 egg bites
- 1 cucumber piece
- 4 baby carrots

| Item | Share of plate | Area |

| Cucumber | 3% | ~17 cm² |
| Carrots | 7% | ~40 cm² |

| Item | Area × height | Volume |
|---|---|---|
| Egg bites | 34 cm² × 3 cm | 102 ml |
| Cucumber | 17 cm² × 2.5 cm | 42 ml |
| Carrots | 40 cm² × 2 cm | 80 ml |

| Item | Volume × density | Weight |
|---|---|---|
| Egg bites | 102 ml × 0.95 | ~97 g |
| Cucumber | 42 ml × 0.7 (solid piece) | ~30 g |
| Carrots | 80 ml × 0.6 | ~48 g |

STEP 7 - Energy:

| Item | Weight × energy density | Energy |
|---|---|---|
| Egg bites (egg and cheese) | 97 g × 190 kcal/100 g | ~184 kcal |
| Cucumber | 30 g × 15 kcal/100 g | ~5 kcal |
| Carrots | 48 g × 35 kcal/100 g | ~17 kcal |

STEP 8 - Sanity check: The total is about 175 g and 206 kcal. That is plausible, since store-bought egg bites are typically about 45–50 g each.
